g.text: A made-up copy of Ollama, from lookfirst's tests
• Matches impersonation patterns: looks like a copy of ollama/ollama
• Gives a password for its download
Matches impersonation patterns: looks like a copy of ollama/ollama
Fake copies of popular projects are a common way to spread malware. This one
resembles ollama/ollama in several of the ways copies do, listed below.
Use the original, ollama/ollama, unless you know why this copy exists.
Gives a password for its download
Password-protected archives hide what's inside from antivirus scans, which is why
"Get Ollama-Installer.7z from the Releases page. Archive password: ollama2026"
Made by an account that's 4 days old
Its README is 100% the same as ollama/ollama's
Add --report FILE to see every detail.
Hidden instructions aimed at AI agents
lookfirst lowers risk; it doesn't guarantee safety.
